settings.heading:
Skin is biology.
Care should respect it.
settings.text: Project Skin was created to move skincare beyond trends and toward better-informed, evidence-led decisions for Indian skin.

settings.heading: Context first
settings.text: Skin concerns make more sense when climate, routine, lifestyle and history are considered together.

settings.heading: Mechanism over trend
settings.text: An ingredient earns its place by what it is meant to do, the role it plays, and how clearly that can be explained.

settings.heading: Consistency over novelty
settings.text: A routine must be usable long enough to learn from it. More products do not automatically create better care.

settings.heading: Care with confidence.
settings.text: Healthy skin is not an overnight outcome. It is a considered process: understand the signal, choose the right mechanism, use it consistently, then review what changed.

settings.card_1_text: We design for Indian skin in real climates — heat, humidity, pollution, hard water and dry winters — instead of treating context as an afterthought.
settings.card_2_text: An ingredient earns its place by mechanism, role and clarity — not trend cycles. Consistency matters more than novelty.

settings.heading: A clearer brief
settings.text: We began with one idea: skincare advice should respect biology, climate and daily life — not marketing theatre.

settings.heading: Formulas with a reason
settings.text: Every active earned its place by mechanism and routine role, built for Indian skin environments.

settings.heading: Guidance that learns
settings.text: Recommendations, routines and check-ins connected — so care can improve with evidence over time.

settings.heading: Human when it matters
settings.text: Technology organizes decisions. A dermatologist remains the right next step for clinical concerns.

settings.heading: Our story in time
settings.text: From a clearer standard for Indian skin to a connected system of guidance, formula and follow-through.

settings.quote: Each of our formulas is a harmony of biology, climate and craft — redefining what modern skincare should mean for Indian skin.

settings.heading: Mechanism, not marketing
settings.text: We explain what an ingredient is there to do and how it fits the routine — without miracle timelines.

settings.heading: Formula integrity
settings.text: Actives, supporting ingredients and delivery systems should work as one considered formula.

settings.heading: Human care when needed
settings.text: Technology can organize information. A dermatologist remains the right route for clinical concerns.

settings.heading: Built to earn your trust
settings.text: Credibility is not a badge. It is how a formula is explained, a recommendation is reasoned, and progress is reviewed without unrealistic promises.

settings.heading:
See the signal.
Build the right routine.
settings.text: Technology that organizes skin context, explains product choices, and helps you follow through — so care gets clearer over time.

settings.heading: Signal over guesswork
settings.text: Visible skin cues and your context are organized into a clearer starting point for cosmetic care.

settings.heading: Mechanism, explained
settings.text: Every recommendation should show what an ingredient is there to do — and why it belongs in your routine.

settings.heading: Learn from consistency
settings.text: Routines and check-ins create usable signal, so the next decision is better informed than the last.

settings.heading: Clarity before another product.
settings.text: We built this layer so you can understand the concern, the mechanism, and the next step — without miracle timelines or ingredient theatre.

settings.image_1_alt: Guided skin scan reviewed with a specialist
settings.card_1_text: Explore the system to turn scattered concerns into an explainable path: what you see, why a product fits, and how to stay consistent.
settings.card_2_heading: Built to learn with your routine
settings.card_2_text: Recommendations matter more when adherence and check-ins create a usable signal — so the next decision is better informed.
settings.image_2_alt: Daily routine guided by Project Skin

settings.heading: Observe
settings.text: A guided image and concern check-in organize visible skin signals into a useful starting point.

settings.heading: Add context
settings.text: Climate, sensitivities, current products and routine history help explain what the image alone cannot.

settings.heading: Match
settings.text: Products are compared by concern, mechanism, formula role and potential routine conflicts.

settings.heading: Review
settings.text: Routine tracking and repeat check-ins create a clearer basis for continuing, changing or escalating care.

settings.heading: Four connected decisions
settings.text: Each layer adds context. Together they turn a one-time recommendation into a more useful skincare system.

settings.heading: A living profile of your skin context
settings.text: A guided scan organizes visible concerns alongside the context you provide. It creates a reusable cosmetic skincare baseline; it does not replace medical diagnosis.
settings.feature_1: Organizes visible acne, pigmentation, texture and barrier cues
settings.feature_2: Adds climate, routine and lifestyle context
settings.feature_3: Creates a consistent baseline for future check-ins

settings.heading: Recommendations with a reason
settings.text: Products are matched to the concern, active mechanism and routine role. Every recommendation should explain what it does and why it belongs.
settings.feature_3: Routine conflicts and unnecessary duplication reduced

settings.heading: A routine you can actually follow
settings.text: Track completed steps, keep product order clear, and build enough consistency to interpret a later skin check-in with better context.

settings.heading: Review what changed
settings.text: Regular check-ins compare the current state with the original baseline so the routine can be reviewed with better context.
settings.feature_2: Routine consistency viewed alongside skin signals
settings.feature_3: Escalation to dermatologist consultation when needed

settings.heading: From signal to smarter routine
settings.text: Project Skin connects analysis, product matching and daily adherence so recommendations can become more relevant over time.

settings.quote: Technology should not sell another trend — it should make the next skincare decision more honest, explainable, and useful.

settings.heading: Guidance, not diagnosis
settings.text: Visible signals help organize cosmetic concerns; clinical symptoms need a dermatologist.

settings.heading: Consent and restraint
settings.text: Collect only what is needed for the experience and make the purpose of that information clear.

settings.heading: A route to human review
settings.text: When concerns fall outside cosmetic guidance, the next step is qualified clinical care.

settings.heading: Useful guidance. Clear limits.
settings.text: Project Skin technology is designed to improve cosmetic skincare decisions. It does not diagnose disease or replace qualified medical care.

settings.heading: Monsoon
settings.text: Humidity does not cancel acne biology.

settings.heading: Festive
settings.text: Celebration skin still needs biology.

settings.heading: Winter
settings.text: Dryness is often a barrier story.

settings.heading: Why percentage belongs on the label
settings.text: Name the dose. Cite the mechanism.

settings.heading: Your moisturiser isn’t failing you
settings.text: When cream fails, start with the lipid layer.

settings.heading: Breakouts aren’t a cleanliness problem
settings.text: Congestion, oil, and barrier stress — diagnosed first.

settings.heading: Education on a calendar.
settings.text: Seasonal climate, ingredient deep dives, and concern literacy — not sale banners.
